text:
jordana: Quick check on where invoice actions should live on the Usage page. Two ideas in Figma: header-primary CTA vs per-row icons. Need a decision for sprint planning.
kevin: Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123  Variant A: header CTA (prominent) + no per-row icons. Variant B: left scope chips + per-row download icons + smaller header overflow.
pm_liu: Finance/legal want a clear, top-level place to get the official invoice PDF. So header CTA is important for Org scope.
anya: UX risk: per-row icons make the table noisy for orgs with many projects; also hard on mobile. If we show per-row, we should hide on small screens behind a row menu.
sam: Perf note: per-row download link requires invoice metadata per project. That could be N extra calls. We could lazy-load metadata for visible rows and provide a batch endpoint for bulk export.
a11y-bot: Accessibility: icon-only buttons need aria-labels like "Download invoice for Project Foo". Toggle for Org/Project must announce scope changes (aria-live or role=tab).
jordana: Compromise proposal: keep header primary CTA for Org scope labeled "Download invoice". When Project scope is active show a per-row download icon but only for rows in viewport (lazy-load). Add a "Download visible" bulk action in header overflow that targets visible rows.
kevin: Added microcopy in mock: "Invoice = official PDF. CSV export available per project." Will show tooltip on hover.
pm_liu: OK with "Download invoice" text. For CSV wording use "Export CSV".
anya: Keyboard/flow: left/right moves scope chips; Enter toggles. Focus should land on the bulk action after invoking it.
sam: Dev estimates: frontend ~2d for header CTA + lazy per-row, backend ~1d for batch metadata endpoint and caching.
jordana: Action items: kevin update figma with responsive variants; sam open backend ticket; anya write accessibility acceptance criteria; pm_liu confirm legal microcopy. I'll mark design-ready when all linked.
a11y-bot: a11y-bot: flagged missing confirmation toast aria-live for completed downloads. Add toast text: "Invoice(s) downloaded" and ensure SR announces success.
jordana: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the links and mark ready-for-dev once tickets exist. :tada:
